question.problem:
What is the circumference $C$ of a circle with a diameter of $d=10?$ 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14183030/assets/b1ebd81fca9688b5688dc916d6be62bad14853f55a8e66c5c7af469dd4032ec4.png)
question.worked_solution:
We use the formula $C=\pi d$ and get

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =\pi d \\  & =\pi \cdot 10 \\  & =10\pi .\end{aligned}
$$

This is the exact answer. If we want an approximate answer, say rounded to three decimal places, we can use the approximation $\pi\approx 3.14\,159,$ and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =10\cdot \pi  \\  & ≈10\cdot 3.14\,159 \\  & ≈31.416.\end{aligned}
$$
